summary: Sudan Shakya works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He held a professorship at Shuchiin University, attested between 2013 and 2026.

Sudhakara Dvivedi (1855–1910) was an Indologist who studied under Devakṛṣṇa. He worked at Sanskrit College and University (~1883–1890) and Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, serving as librarian (1883) and later professor and head of the mathematics faculty (1890, 1898–1905).

Sudhir Kakar (1938–2024) studied at Gujarat University, Mannheim, Vienna, and the Sigmund-Freud-Institut. A scholar of religious studies, he held posts at Harvard, IIM Ahmedabad (~1971–1975), and IIT Delhi (1976–1977), alongside visiting roles at institutions including INSEAD (1994–2013).

Sue Hamilton is a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Indology. She earned her D.Phil. at the University of Oxford under Richard Gombrich and Alexis Sanderson, and was affiliated with King's College London (attested 2001–2003).

Suk Fun Ng is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2014) under doctoral supervisors Jing Yin and Yakupitiyage Karunadasa, having also studied under K. L. Dhammajoti.

Sukhlal Sanghvi (1880–1978) was a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied under Balakrishna Mishra. He taught Indian philosophy at Gujarat Vidyapith (1922) and held the Chair of Jain Philosophy at Banaras Hindu University (1934–1944).

Sukumar Sen (1900–1992) was a linguist and Indologist who studied at the University of Calcutta under Suniti Kumar Chatterji and Irach Jehangir Sorabji Taraporewala. At Calcutta, he served as lecturer (1930) and later Khaira Professor (1954).

Sukumari Bhattacharji (1921–2014) was an Indologist and religious studies scholar. Educated at the University of Calcutta and Jadavpur University, she taught English at Lady Brabourne College (1945) and was a faculty member at Jadavpur University (1957–1986).
Sulagna Bhattacharya is an Indologist who conducted doctoral research under Pratap Bandyopadhyay and held an H P Shastri Research Fellowship at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sulak Sivaraksa (born 1933) is an author in Buddhist studies and philosophy who studied at the University of Wales, Lampeter (~1954–1957). He held visiting professorships at UC Berkeley, Harvard, Toronto, and Cornell, and was an honorary fellow at Lampeter.

Sumanapala Galmangoda is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology. He served as Senior Professor at the University of Kelaniya (attested 2012) and Director of the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies (attested 2007, 2012).

Sumathi Ramaswamy (born 1961) is a historian and Indologist educated at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Pennsylvania. She held faculty appointments at the University of Pennsylvania (~1993–2000) and the University of Michigan (~2000–2007).

Sumi Lee is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. She earned an MA at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign under Alexander Leonhard Mayer and a PhD at the University of California, Los Angeles under Robert E. Buswell Jr.

Sumitra Mangesh Katre (1906–1998) was an Indologist and linguist who earned his Ph.D. at the University of London (~1928–1931). He held the Chair of Indo-European Philology at Deccan College (1942–1971) and taught at UT Austin (~1971–1976).

Sun-Ah Choi is a scholar of Buddhist studies and history/archaeology. She completed a PhD at the University of Chicago, supervised by Juhyung Rhi and taught by Richard Neer, Robert S. Nelson, Jaś Elsner, and Aden Kumler.

Sunanda Mukhopadhyay works in linguistics and Indology. She completed doctoral research under Shyam Sundar Bhattacharya and held a post as a research scholar/fellow at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sung-Bae Park (born 1933) is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar who earned his doctorate under Lewis Lancaster (~1975–1979). He served as an assistant professor at Dongguk University and later taught at Stony Brook University from 1977.

Sungdoo Ahn is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar who earned his PhD at the University of Hamburg (-2001) under Lambert Schmithausen. He served as Director at Geumgang University and Professor at Seoul National University (attested 2013).

Sungtaek Cho (born 1957) is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. He held posts at Stony Brook University and Korea University, where he served as Director in 2003 and Professor (attested 2017).
Sunhee Kim completed a Doctor of Philosophy in Performance Practice at the University of Exeter under the supervision of Phillip B. Zarrilli (attested 2013).
